proof_attempt_summary: Discovery developed a noncompact Gaussian certification framework, variance-ratio stability, and uniform deterministic finite-budget rounding, then corrected and attested the two remaining sources. D0.5 rejected the replayability of the proper-face numerical enclosure and found the central evaluated recruitment saddle unresolved, with achieved tier incremental below field. Re-raise requires new exact certificate infrastructure and saddle/contact analysis; no Lean formalization was reached.
tldr: Overlapping deployment caps couple the value of information: each stratum informs several competing policy utilities. The declared Gaussian contrast experiment has a general finite-certificate theorem and proved strict fixed identity-covariance separation from every proper face. The frontier \(C(\eta)\) is nondecreasing and continuous, with \(\lvert\log C(\eta')-\log C(\eta)\rvert\le\frac12\lvert\log\eta'-\log\eta\rvert\). Every optimal recruitment set is nonempty and compact, its correspondence is upper hemicontinuous, and its shares are uniformly positive on compact variance-ratio ranges. Legal even-budget attainment obeys \(R_N(\eta)=C(\eta)N^{-1/2}+O_H(N^{-3/2})\) uniformly for \(\eta\) in any compact \(H\subset(0,\infty)\), with rounded shares within \(8/N\) of a chosen optimizer. The quantitative large-middle-variance result remains \(C(\eta)/\sqrt\eta=c/3+O(\eta^{-1/3})\) and \(1-q_2=O(\eta^{-1/3})\) uniformly over optimal shares. The exact finite-ratio saddle, deterministic symmetry, contact and policy-region structure, and executed full-design \(\eta=1\) certificate remain open.
gap: Hu et al. evaluates sampling through independently selectable subgroup decisions. Joo characterizes full-support multivariate location selection and specializes to Gaussian rewards with arbitrary covariance. Neither cited result evaluates the rank-three singular utility map \(\mathcal U\) for five pyramid deployment actions jointly with optimization over deterministic information shares \(q\).
fill: An evaluated \(C(\eta)\) for every positive variance ratio, optimal deterministic recruitment, global policy regions, and matching certificates would quantify this information sharing under unrestricted effects. The contribution is the coupled saddle of this pyramid. Certificates 1 and 2 require outward-error accounting, finite termination with realized operation counts, and a design-wide benchmark for \(3C(1)\). The stopping schedule and its exact accounting are Stage 0 obligations; a worst-case complexity bound is not claimed.
